english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being out of danger, free from risk, protected, or securely kept.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when a person, place, or possession is free from physical danger or theft.

examples.english: This place is very secure, so you don't need to worry walking home at night.
examples.traditional: 呢度好安全，夜晚行返屋企都唔使驚。
